note: Times are seconds in the raw file. 'remove' takes out the words and the silence in the range. 'tighten' keeps every word and shortens only the silence in the range. The length a tightened pause is cut down to is a stage 2 style decision, so 'target_seconds' is empty. No edit has been built from this list yet. Check each edge by ear before rendering: word times next to a silence can be off by a few tenths.
